name: MagicReply
oneLiner: AI tool that drafts and posts replies to Google Business Profile reviews in a business's own voice, with auto-reply rules and a Chrome extension.
bestFor: Independent restaurants, cafes and small groups that mainly need fast, on-brand replies to Google reviews at a low monthly price.

updates.text: Voice profiles became per location (March 14, 2026), so each storefront can reply in its own voice; review request emails with a direct Google review link per location were added March 12, 2026.
Chrome Extension 2.0 inserts AI replies directly into Google's review box, with tone and length selectors (month not confirmed).

features: AI-drafted replies to Google Business Profile reviews that you can edit or regenerate before posting
Voice profile learned from your past replies (greeting, sign-off, vocabulary), set per location
Auto-reply rules by star rating, keywords or sentiment
Restaurant reply templates covering food quality, service, wait times and value
Chrome extension that inserts replies into Google's review interface
Review request emails and a shareable Google review link for each location
Team approval workflows and review analytics

pricing.text: Free plan (limited AI replies and Google posts per month for 1 location); Pro $19.99/month; Business $49.99/month with unlimited locations; 7-day trial on paid plans.

notes: Small product from Somnus Labs Inc. (per its terms); no named customers or press coverage found, so customers is empty. Free-plan limits conflict between the FAQ (15 AI replies, 5 posts to Google per month) and the changelog (3 to 5 AI replies), so the review should not state exact free limits. Google-only: no Yelp, TripAdvisor or delivery-app reviews confirmed. 'Dish-aware' replies are the vendor's restaurant positioning; homepage testimonials are self-published and unverified. Prices from search snippets of magicreply.ai (site not fetchable).
